_comment: The reference player every strength claim is measured against (user ruling 2026-10-04; docs/plan_20260904.md 3, rule 1). One checkpoint, its memory, one decode. tools/reference_player.py reads this file: `--flags a|b` prints the run_elo_batch flags for that side, `--ensure` fetches the checkpoint from the model host when the local copy is missing.
label: parity3
